query: Write my weekly update for Kristina.
expected_behavior: Runs the bundled weekly-activity.sh to fetch the window's Jira (and GitHub when available) activity rather than re-deriving the JQL and date math by hand, defaulting to since-last-Monday
Asks the three soft questions (blockers, decisions, cross-team) in a single batched AskUserQuestion call
Composes Kristina's 6-section template as a plain-text email body (no markdown, no em dashes), applying the roll-up rule for multi-ticket bullets
Copies the body to the clipboard via pbcopy and never auto-sends — the user pastes and sends it themselves
